about_the_game:
Take control of our firefighter.
He's young, handsome and strong as an ox. Not only that, but he also leads a very exciting life. Not many women can resist such a hot and brave man.

One day, his life takes a turn into the unknown, when his lifelong "friend" Nora stops by his apartment.
Looks like Nora isn't having that much luck in her love life, and after finding out that her boyfriend is cheating on her, she seeks refuge with our firefighter. Not only that she needs a place to stay, but she also needs help with a work get together where she was supposed to introduce her boyfriend.

Now single and without the courage to tell her boss the truth, Nora convinces our young firefighter to help her with a plan to secure her position in the firm, no mater what it takes. But of course it isn't all that simple. You don't think our firefighter is all that and single? NO! Of course not! He's got a lot of female admirers. And frankly, I wonder how they'll react to the whole situation.

What will you do? How far will you go? Only one way to find out!

WARNING!

This game is for ADULTS only and it includes explicit, sexual content that some viewers may find offensive. The characters shown in the game are all over 18 years old.
